report.clinical_summary: Male patient with history of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) and Agent Orange exposure is on maintenance Venetoclax 400 mg daily. He reports significant symptoms including fatigue, recurrent infections, swollen lymph nodes, night sweats, early satiety, and unintentional weight loss. He takes Venetoclax consistently as prescribed but experiences headaches and occasional nausea as side effects. The illness has substantially impacted his daily activities, social life, and routines, forcing him to stay home more often and modify how he manages tasks. He understands CLL as a chronic, lifelong condition and anticipates ongoing treatment, but feels a significant loss of control and expresses emotional distress about uncertainty and potential disease progression.
